mapper.sql: FROM attendance_record r JOIN edu_student s ON s.id = r.student_id JOIN sys_organization c ON c.id = r.class_organization_id

choose.when: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_teacher_class tc WHERE tc.teacher_user_id = #{scope.userId} AND tc.class_organization_id = c.id AND tc.status = 'ACTIVE')

mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS classOrganizationId, c.organization_name AS className FROM sys_organization c WHERE c.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND c.status = 'ENABLED' AND c.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND ORDER BY c.organization_path, c.sort_order, c.id
SELECT c.id FROM sys_organization c WHERE c.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND c.status = 'ENABLED' AND c.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName FROM edu_student s WHERE s.status = 'ENABLED' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_parent_student ps WHERE ps.parent_user_id = #{userId} AND ps.student_id = s.id AND ps.status = 'ACTIVE') OR s.student_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY s.id

SELECT r.id, s.student_name, c.organization_name AS class_name, r.attendance_date, r.status, r.checkin_time, r.checkout_time
AND r.id > #{cursor} AND r.id <= #{upperBound} ORDER BY r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
